actions.label_short: Supreme Court: IEEPA does not authorize tariffs
actions.description: The Supreme Court decides Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump. Its summary of the holding reads: "The International Emergency Economic Powers Act, 91 Stat. 1626, does not authorize the President to impose tariffs." The judgment in No. 24-1287 is vacated and remanded with instructions to dismiss for lack of jurisdiction; the judgment in No. 25-250 is affirmed.
actions.status_note: The Court issued its judgment on March 24, 2026 (docket).
